title: John Aristotle Phillips' atomic bomb junior thesis at Princeton

tellings.quote: You had a guy named John Aristotle Phillips who was a junior at Princeton who chose Freeman Dyson for his advisor for his junior thesis.

plain: In the mid-1970s a Princeton junior named John Aristotle Phillips wrote his junior thesis about an atomic bomb, with the physicist Freeman Dyson as his chosen adviser. The researcher Eric Weinstein brings it up on the show from memory, without naming a source, as an example of how far a student could get on such a subject. The thesis itself is dated in the story to about 1976 to 1977.
